```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(tinyAM)
library(plotly)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = FALSE)
htmltools::tagList(htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML('
  [data-dropdown-tabs] .dropdown-toggle { background: transparent; }
  [data-dropdown-tabs] .nav-tabs .dropdown-toggle.dropdown-selected {
    color: #4D4D4D; background-color: #fff; border-color: #B2B2B2 #B2B2B2 #fff;
  }
  [data-dropdown-tabs] .dropdown-item.dropdown-selected { color: white; background-color: #003e56; }
')), htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(paste(readLines(
  system.file("js", "dashboard-dropdowns.js", package = "tinyAM"), warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"))))
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}

tabs <- tidy_tam(model_list = fits, label = "model", label_type = "factor", interval = interval,
  process_seed = process_seed)
set_model_levels <- function(x, model_names) {
  if (is.data.frame(x) && "model" %in% names(x)) {
    x$model <- factor(as.character(x$model), levels = model_names)
  } else if (is.list(x)) {
    x[] <- lapply(x, set_model_levels, model_names = model_names)
  }
  x
}
tabs <- set_model_levels(tabs, names(fits))
if (exists("retro_origins") && !is.null(retro_origins)) {
  tabs <- tinyAM:::.retro_plot_metadata(tabs, retro_origins)
}
obs_pred <- tabs$obs_pred
pop <- tabs$pop
fixed_par <- tabs$fixed_par
random_par <- tabs$random_par
formula_effects <- tabs$formula_effects
check_models <- Filter(function(fit) inherits(fit, "tam_fit"), fits)
checks <- if (length(check_models)) check_tam(model_list = check_models) else list()
ssb_timing <- data.frame(Model = names(fits), Timing = vapply(fits, function(fit) {
  if (!inherits(fit, "tam_fit")) return("Reference definition; see Background")
  tinyAM:::.ssb_timing_label(fit$dat)
}, character(1)))
ssb_label <- "SSB"

```


```{r helpers, include = FALSE}

cols <- tam_pal(length(fits))

plot_rows <- function(d, columns) {
  if (!is.data.frame(d)) return(NULL)
  columns <- intersect(columns, names(d))
  if (!length(columns)) return(d[0, , drop = FALSE])
  keep <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(columns, function(nm) is.finite(d[[nm]])))
  d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

mortality_plot_data <- function(data, mean, fits, component) {
  for (nm in c("est", "lwr", "upr")) data[[paste0("mean_", nm)]] <- NA_real_
  if (is.null(mean) || !nrow(mean)) return(data)
  if (component == "F") {
    no_mean <- names(fits)[vapply(fits, function(fit) {
      inherits(fit, "tam_fit") && is.null(fit$dat$F_settings$mu_form)
    }, logical(1))]
    mean <- mean[!mean$model %in% no_mean, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  keys <- c("model", "year", "age", "is_proj")
  key <- function(d) do.call(paste, c(d[keys], sep = "\r"))
  rows <- match(key(data), key(mean))
  for (nm in intersect(c("est", "lwr", "upr"), names(mean))) {
    data[[paste0("mean_", nm)]] <- mean[[nm]][rows]
  }
  data
}

plot_mortality <- function(data, mean_line = list(dash = "dot", width = .5), ...) {
  for (nm in c("lwr", "upr")) {
    if (is.null(data[[nm]])) data[[nm]] <- NA_real_
  }
  p <- plot_trend(data, add_buttons = FALSE, ...)
  if (any(is.finite(data$mean_est))) {
    if (any(is.finite(data$mean_upr))) {
      p <- plotly::add_ribbons(p, ymin = ~mean_lwr, ymax = ~mean_upr,
        opacity = .15, line = list(width = 0), showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "skip")
    }
    # Missing reference means must not drop or shift animation traces.
    data$mean_est[is.na(data$mean_est)] <- Inf
    p <- plotly::add_lines(p, data = data, y = ~mean_est, showlegend = FALSE,
      line = mean_line,
      hovertemplate = "Process mean: %{y}<br>%{text}<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
    values <- unlist(data[c("est", "upr", "mean_est", "mean_upr")])
    p <- plotly::layout(p, yaxis = list(range = c(0, max(c(0, values[is.finite(values)])) * 1.05)))
  }
  add_plot_buttons(p)
}

make_resid_plots <- function(d) {
  fitted_models <- names(fits)[vapply(fits, inherits, logical(1), "tam_fit")]
  d <- d[d$model %in% fitted_models, , drop = FALSE]
  if ("osa_res" %in% names(d) && !any(is.finite(d$osa_res))) {
    d$osa_res <- NULL
  }
  residual <- if ("osa_res" %in% names(d)) "osa_res" else "std_res"
  d <- droplevels(plot_rows(d, residual))
  if (!nrow(d)) {
    return(setNames(rep(list(plotly::plot_ly()), 5),
                    c("bubbles", "year", "age", "cohort", "expected")))
  }
  frame <- if (length(unique(d$model)) > 1L) ~model else NULL
  resid_cols <- cols[match(levels(d$model), names(fits))]
  list(bubbles = plot_bubbles(d, frame = frame, colors = tam_pal(2)),
       year = plot_resid(d, x = ~year, xlab = "Year", frame = frame, color = ~model, colors = resid_cols),
       age = plot_resid(d, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", frame = frame, color = ~model, colors = resid_cols),
       cohort = plot_resid(d, x = ~(year - age), xlab = "Cohort", frame = frame, color = ~model, colors = resid_cols),
       expected = plot_resid(d, x = ~log(pred), xlab = "Expected", frame = frame, color = ~model, colors = resid_cols))
}

table_link <- function(x, table_name = NULL, download_text = "Download table") {
  d <- tempdir()
  f <- file.path(d, paste0(table_name, ".csv"))
  write.csv(x, file = f)
  xfun::embed_file(f, text = "Download table")
}
```
